news.title: Meta’s loss is Thinking Machines’ gain
news.description: Meta has been poaching talent from Thinking Machines Lab. But it's a two-way street.

news.title: ComfyUI hits $500M valuation as creators seek more control over AI-generated media
news.description: ComfyUI, whose tools give creators more control over AI image, video, and audio generation, just raised $30 million.

news.title: Google to invest up to $40B in Anthropic in cash and compute
news.description: Google plans up to $40B investment in Anthropic as AI rivals race to secure massive compute capacity, following the limited release of its powerful, cybersecurity-focused Mythos model.

news.title: OpenAI boss 'deeply sorry' for not telling police of mass shooting suspect's account
news.description: Sam Altman on Thursday wrote a brief letter of apology to the people of Tumbler Ridge, Canada in the wake of a January mass shooting.

news.title: Meta to cut one in 10 jobs after spending billions on AI
news.description: The cuts, which employees had been expecting for weeks, will be Meta's largest layoff since 2023.

news.title: Discord Sleuths Gained Unauthorized Access to Anthropic’s Mythos
news.description: Plus: Spy firms tap into a global telecom weakness to track targets, 500,000 UK health records go up for sale on Alibaba, Apple patches a revealing notification bug, and more.

news.title: AI-Designed Drugs by a DeepMind Spinoff Are Headed to Human Trials
news.description: Isomorphic Labs president Max Jaderberg said at WIRED Health in London that the startup has built a “broad and exciting pipeline of new medicines.”

news.title: Apple's Next CEO Needs to Launch a Killer AI Product
news.description: Tim Cook was a great CEO, but he didn’t crack AI.  It’s job number 1 for John Ternus.
